[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] '''Darreen Spenss''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] who fought during the [[Second Battle of Coruscant]]. Spenss led a force to secure a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] that had been targeted by opportunistic [[Scavenger/Legends|scavengers]].
